meta.product: ILOSTAT EIP 3EET: NEET: Youth not in employment, education or training by sex and age; NEET rate: Share of youth not in employment, education or training by sex and age
meta.coverage: NEET: Youth not in employment, education or training by sex and age; NEET rate: Share of youth not in employment, education or training by sex and age. HS - National Sample Survey, annual
meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: Computed by the ILO from NSS unit-level data. Each round runs July to June and is labelled by the year it ends (2012 = July 2011 to June 2012). Observations flagged U are ones the ILO itself marks unreliable.
sourceNotes: Data reference period: Noncalendar year (72 obs.)
Break in series: Methodology revised (24 obs.)
